name: motif_overview
description:
Read the project Overview. Displays the latest saved counts, Text Coverage, manual-analysis agreement, timing, and warnings. It reads stored evidence and does not start a new run.
Command: overview. Agent class: Read.
ProposalId: The Proposal whose latest Trial supplies the evidence, or null for the project.

name: motif_capture_baseline
description:
Capture a Baseline. Reads the saved .fwdata project to create or reuse a file-backed Baseline. Use it when the latest FieldWorks save should be the point of comparison for later work.
Command: baseline capture. Agent class: Evaluate.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_grammar

query.description: Only objects whose name or abbreviation contains this text.

offset.description: Items to skip, for the next page.

name: motif_lexicon
description: Read lexicon. Searches Baseline entries and counts them by morph type and category. Filter by morphType, affix, category, headword or hasGloss. Concise results are one line per entry with its sense ids; detailed results include senses, allomorphs and their environments.

headword.description: Only entries whose headword starts with this text.

headwordContains.description: Only entries whose headword contains this text.

Word: The exact word form to read.
ExpectedBaseline: The required Baseline identity; null accepts the current Baseline.

name: motif_start_proposal
description:
Start a Proposal. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow; check best practice. Start one small Proposal per grammar question, then try it before anything else (guide workflow). Starts a named Draft holding one related set of semantic changes. Set a short label and a Rationale before Finalize, then measure and revise the Draft. Only a person can Apply.
Command: new. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
Label: The short description a person reads while reviewing the Proposal.

label.description: A one-line description a reviewer reads in Motif's window.

rationale.description: What this Proposal changes and why, in Markdown: the evidence, in a few sentences.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_lexeme_form
description:
Author a lexeme form. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a lexeme form with explicitly authored spelling, writing system and morph type in a Draft. Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize; only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-lexeme-form. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

morph_type.description: Id of the morph type of the new form.

ws.description: Writing system tag the form is written in.

environments.description: Optional environment ids restricting the new form.

is_abstract.description: True for a root-and-pattern form with no fixed segments.

sense.description: Id of an existing sense of the entry to gloss. Needs gloss_ws and gloss_text.

gloss_ws.description: Writing system tag of the gloss.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_feature_structure
description:
Author grammatical features. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Stages an empty feature structure on an existing or earlier-staged stem, inflectional affix or derivational affix MSA (side from or to) in a Draft, refusing an occupied slot even when its structure has no selections. Inflectional affix features are word requirements; use the returned exact structure identity to author selections. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-feature-structure. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: Closed {msa, side?} input naming the exact canonical MSA identity; side (from or to) is required for a derivational affix and refused otherwise. Its MsFeatures, InflFeats, FromMsFeatures or ToMsFeatures owning slot must be unoccupied; a present structure is refused even with no selections. Inflectional affix features are word requirements. Use the returned structure identity for selections.

msa.description: Id of a stem, inflectional affix or derivational affix MSA with no existing feature structure in the slot.

side.description: Derivational affix only: "from" (a requirement unified with the stem's features: a stem with another value is refused, one with none passes) or "to" (carried by the derived stem, replacing the stem's value of that feature).

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_phoneme
description:
Author a phoneme. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Add a phoneme for a real contrast, not only to record a surface variant, unless a rule needs it as an output segment (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages a phoneme with literal representations, including symbols such as parentheses and slash, and optional explicit feature values. Put case spellings of the same sound on that phoneme; use its created identity in natural classes or phonological rules. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

representations.description: Explicit grapheme codes, such as ['a'] or ['sh', 'š'].

value.description: Symbolic value belonging to that feature.

name: motif_add_natural_class
description:
Author a natural class. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep sound classes narrow: list only the sounds the pattern needs, never a class spanning unrelated sounds (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a named segment natural class with explicitly declared phoneme members in a Draft. Members may name existing phonemes or phonemes created earlier through declared dependencies. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-natural-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

members.description: Phoneme ids in the first set.

feature.description: Closed feature id in the phonological feature system.

value.description: Symbolic value belonging to that feature.

features.description: Closed phonological feature/value pairs; copy ids from motif_grammar.

name: motif_add_environment
description:
Author an environment. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs or nasal-assimilation; check best practice. Keep the environment as narrow as the evidence. For a regular change across many forms use a phonological rule, not environments (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages an environment with explicitly declared left and right contexts in a Draft. Contexts use project phonemes, natural classes or boundaries. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-environment. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

name: motif_add_phonological_rule
description:
Author a phonological rule. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or phonological-rules or feature-rules; check best practice. Use for a regular sound change across many forms. Not for one irregular word: use an alternate form or allomorph (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Stages one regular phonological rule in a Draft, with one or more ordered right-hand sides, each with its own Output, contexts and rule features, and up to eight items in each Input and Output sequence. Output classes allow lexical alternatives; overlapping right-hand sides use the first applicable case, while feature changes preserve other features and alpha variables express agreement or disagreement. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phonological-rule. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.

name: motif_add_inflection_feature
description:
Author inflection feature. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Adds a closed morphosyntactic feature and its named values to a Draft. Use the created ids in feature-structure and stem-name authoring, then Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize.
Command: compose-author-inflection-feature. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The Draft to append the authored operations to.
IntentJson: The closed inflection feature input, resolved against the prepared Draft.

name: motif_add_inflection_class
description:
Author inflection class. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only when stems arbitrarily pattern differently for the same affix. A value that must agree is a feature, not a class (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Adds an inflection class or subclass, such as a noun class, to a Draft. Its owner is explicit and the category's default is unchanged; use the created id when authoring a stem.
Command: compose-author-inflection-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The Draft to append the authored operations to.
IntentJson: The closed inflection class input, resolved against the prepared Draft.

name: motif_add_stem_name
description:
Author a stem name. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Only names feature conditions; attach it with compose-edit-stem-allomorph-stem-name. For sound-conditioned forms use environments, not a stem name (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Adds a category-owned stem name with explicit feature regions to a Draft. Each region states where an allomorph bearing this stem name is eligible; attaching it to an allomorph is a separate operation.
Command: compose-author-stem-name. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The Draft to append the authored operations to.
IntentJson: The closed stem name input, resolved against the prepared Draft.

feature.description: Closed feature id in the morphosyntactic system.

name: motif_add_lexical_entry
description:
Author a lexical entry. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. For an affix, prefer an inflectional or derivational MSA with categories and a slot over unclassified (guide suffix-prefix-slots). One entry per morpheme, not per stem. Stages one new dictionary entry with its lexeme form, one sense with gloss and optional definition, and grammatical info: a stem, or an inflectional, derivational or unclassified affix. An inflectional affix can name the inflection classes its form attaches to; use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction for a derivational affix. Inspect its Dry Run and try words with it before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-author-lexical-entry. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

formWs.description: Vernacular writing system tag of the form.

morphType.description: Canonical id of the morph type, such as stem, root, prefix or suffix.

environments.description: Canonical ids of the phonological environments this form occurs in; omit for any.

category.description: Canonical id of the part of speech; for a derivational affix, the one it attaches to.

toCategory.description: Derivational only: canonical id of the part of speech it makes.

slots.description: Inflectional only: canonical ids of existing slots the affix fills.

inflectionClass.description: Stem only: canonical id of its inflection class, such as a noun class.

exceptionFeatures.description: Stem only: canonical ids of existing exception features the analysis carries.

name: motif_add_alternate_form
description:
Author an alternate form. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use for a listed variant of one morpheme. Not for a regular sound change, a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation), or a pattern-based form (compose-author-affix-process-allomorph). Stages one more stem or affix form on an existing or earlier-staged entry, with its own environments and, when the entry has inflectional grammatical info, inflection classes. Use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction for a derivational analysis. It adds no entry, sense or grammatical info and copies no condition from the lexeme form.
Command: compose-author-alternate-form. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

inflectionClasses.description: Affix entries only: canonical ids of the inflection classes of the stems this form attaches to; omit for no restriction.

before.description: Existing alternate form after the insertion gap.

name: motif_add_part_of_speech
description:
Author a part of speech. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Add a category only when the evidence needs one; slots and classes belong to a category, so author it before them (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a new part of speech, at the top of the category list or under an existing category, with its name and optional abbreviation. Later composer calls in the same Draft can use it as the category of entries, slots and affixes.

name: motif_add_affix_process
description:
Author an affix process. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use for infixes, reduplication and stem-internal changes. Another pattern-based form of an existing entry: compose-author-affix-process-allomorph. Regular nasal assimilation is a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a new affix entry whose ordered input pattern matches phonemes, a natural class or the remaining stem, and whose output copies named parts, inserts phonemes, inserts a segment of a natural class, or copies a part with the features of a feature class laid over it: an infix, a partial or full reduplication, or a substitution that deletes matched input by omitting it from the output (Cebuano paN- before p/b gives m). It refuses an output that copies nothing or drops the remaining stem. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-author-affix-process. Agent class: Draft.

morphType.description: Id of an affix morph type such as prefix, suffix or infix.

analysisWs.description: Analysis writing system tag for the gloss and definition.

form.description: Optional headword shown for the entry, in the vernacular writing system formWs, without the hyphens FieldWorks shows on affixes (for example in for the infix -in-). Give it with formWs.

formWs.description: Vernacular writing system tag for form.

msa.description: Affix grammatical info: kind inflectional, derivational or unclassified, its category, and for derivational toCategory, for inflectional slots.

input.description: Ordered pattern parts, each with a name and one of phoneme, naturalClass or remaining true; the remaining-stem part is last.

output.description: Ordered realization, each item exactly one of: copy of a named input part; insert of phoneme ids; insertClass, the id of a natural class one of whose segments is inserted (a class of several segments leaves the choice of member to the parser); modify, the name of an input part (a phoneme, a natural class or the remaining stem), with features, the id of a feature natural class laid over the copied part. An input part left out of the output is deleted.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_affix_process_allomorph
description:
Add an affix process allomorph. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs or workflow; check best practice. Use for one morpheme with several pattern-based forms. Plain spelling variants use an alternate form; a new morpheme needs its own entry (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Stages one more pattern-based form, an affix process with its own input pattern and output, on an existing affix entry whose forms may be plain allomorphs or processes. The lexeme form's morph type is copied and the form applies to all of the entry's grammatical info. It refuses a stem, a repeated pattern and a missing placement.
Command: compose-author-affix-process-allomorph. Agent class: Draft.

entry.description: Id of the existing affix entry that gains the process.

input.description: Ordered pattern parts, each with a name and one of phoneme, naturalClass or remaining true; the remaining-stem part is last.

output.description: Ordered realization, each item exactly one of: copy of a named input part; insert of phoneme ids; insertClass, the id of a natural class one of whose segments is inserted (a class of several segments leaves the choice of member to the parser); modify, the name of an input part (a phoneme, a natural class or the remaining stem), with features, the id of a feature natural class laid over the copied part. An input part left out of the output is deleted.

inflectionClasses.description: Optional ids of inflection classes of the stems this form attaches to. Inflectional affixes only; a derivational affix is refused (use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction).

placement.description: The neighbouring alternate form ids, after, before or both; required when the entry already has alternate forms.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_feature_value
description:
Author a feature value. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Stages a closed feature specification in an existing or earlier-staged structure, with value omitted when unchosen. Inflectional affix requirements use current morphosyntactic definitions, and any supplied value must belong to the exact feature. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-feature-value. Agent class: Draft.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_allomorph_required_features
description:
Add Required Features. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use for one form's Required Features; whole-affix requirements use compose-author-feature-structure. Stages Required Features on an ordinary affix allomorph in a Draft. Populate the returned structure with feature values to select the form by the stem's grammatical features, including on derivational affixes. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-allomorph-required-features. Agent class: Draft.

allomorph.description: Ordinary affix allomorph id with no existing Required Features structure. May be earlier-staged.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_remove_feature_value
description:
Remove a feature value. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Remove a requirement only when the affix really takes every value; to change a value, remove it and author the new one (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Stages the removal of one feature's specification from a stem's MsFeatures, an inflectional affix's InflFeats, or a derivational affix's FromMsFeatures or ToMsFeatures, so the stem stops carrying the feature or the affix stops requiring or giving it. The feature structure stays. Refuses a feature the structure does not specify. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-remove-feature-value. Agent class: Draft.

featStruc.description: Id of the feature structure on a stem, inflectional affix or derivational affix.

feature.description: Id of the feature whose specification is removed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_change_affix_kind
description:
Change an affix’s kind. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. Choose inflectional or derivational on the evidence and change it later if it was wrong; leaving an affix unclassified is a stopgap (guides suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a change of one affix between inflectional, derivational and unclassified in place, keeping its category and the senses that use it. What the new kind cannot hold, such as a template slot or a To category, is reported as a warning, not refused. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-change-affix-kind. Agent class: Draft.

msa.description: Id of the affix’s current grammatical info.

kind.description: New kind: inflectional, derivational or unclassified.

toCategory.description: For derivational only: id of the category of the word it makes; the attaching category when absent.

slots.description: For inflectional only: ids of the existing slots it fills.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_phoneme
description:
Edit a phoneme's representations. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Edit a phoneme for a real contrast, not only to record a surface variant, unless a rule needs it as an output segment (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages new written representations for an existing phoneme, or respells one it has, so a multigraph such as ng, ts or dy is another way the same segment is written and never a second phoneme. It refuses a spelling another phoneme or boundary already has, and a respelling that an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-edit-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

add.description: New representations to append, each an object with a representation, such as ng.

respell.description: Current representations to replace in place, each with from and to.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_phonological_feature
description:
Author a phonological feature. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or archiphonemes; check best practice. Use for a phonological feature of sounds. An inflection or part-of-speech feature uses compose-author-inflection-feature; a word-level exception uses compose-author-exception-feature (guide archiphonemes). Stages a closed phonological feature and its values in the project's phonological feature system, such as place with labial, coronal and velar. Phonemes carry the values and a natural class can be defined by them. Defining the first feature of a featureless project changes how rewrite rules that name segment classes are read, so Trial the rules after it. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phonological-feature. Agent class: Draft.

abbreviation.description: Optional feature abbreviation, unique among phonological features.

values.description: Nonempty list of values, each an object with a name and an optional abbreviation; select one later in a batch with @label:values:NAME.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_phonological_feature_value
description:
Add a phonological feature value. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation; check best practice. Extend a feature that exists. Create the feature first with compose-author-phonological-feature (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages one more value for an existing closed phonological feature. The feature must belong to the phonological feature system, and the value name and abbreviation must be new to it. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-add-phonological-feature-value. Agent class: Draft.

feature.description: Id of a saved or earlier staged phonological feature, @label in a batch, or lookup:phonological-feature:NAME.

abbreviation.description: Optional value abbreviation, unique within the feature.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_phoneme_features
description:
Set a phoneme's features. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or archiphonemes; check best practice. Set the features of a phoneme that exists; a new phoneme can take features when it is authored (guides nasal-assimilation, archiphonemes). Stages feature values on an existing phoneme: set a value (a feature the phoneme already has takes the new value in place, one it lacks gains it) and clear features. A phoneme with no feature structure gets one. It refuses a value that does not belong to its feature, a feature both set and cleared, a clear of an absent feature and a change that alters nothing. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-phoneme-features. Agent class: Draft.

set.description: Feature and value pairs to set, each an object with feature and value ids.

clear.description: Ids of features whose specification is removed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_natural_class_features
description:
Edit a natural class's features. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation; check best practice. Change the feature constraints of a class defined by features. A class defined by segments changes its members with compose-edit-natural-class (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a change to the feature values that define a feature-based natural class: set a constraint (a feature the class already constrains takes the new value in place) and clear constraints. The class must keep at least one constraint, and a segment class is refused. The response lists the environments, rules and insertions that use the class. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-natural-class-features. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Id of the existing feature-based natural class.

set.description: Feature and value pairs to set, each an object with feature and value ids.

clear.description: Ids of features whose constraint is removed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_merge_phoneme
description:
Merge a phoneme into another. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Merge phonemes only when the language has no contrast between them, since the contrast cannot be recovered from the words afterwards (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages a merge of one phoneme into another: each spelling of the first becomes another way to write the second, and the first phoneme is removed from the inventory and from its natural classes. It refuses a spelling another phoneme has, a natural class the first phoneme alone fills, and a rule or environment that uses the first phoneme. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-merge-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

source.description: Id of the phoneme to merge away.

target.description: Id of the phoneme that keeps its identity and gains the spellings.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_split_phoneme
description:
Split a spelling into a phoneme. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Split a spelling out only for a real contrast, then add the new phoneme to its natural classes (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages the move of one spelling of a phoneme into a new phoneme of its own, which undoes a merge. The phoneme keeps its other spellings, and the new phoneme starts with no natural class and no features. It refuses a spelling an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-split-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

source.description: Id of the phoneme that has the spelling now.

representation.description: The spelling to move out, such as o.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_derivational_affix_restriction
description:
Restrict a derivational affix. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. For a derivational affix only. An inflectional affix is restricted by the inflection classes on its form (compose-edit-affix-inflection-classes). Sets, replaces or explicitly clears the From Inflection Class and the To Inflection Class, and can set the exact From Exception Features and To Exception Features on an existing affix entry's derivational grammatical info; alsoMsas applies the same change to many affixes. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction. Agent class: Draft.

msa.description: Id of the derivational grammatical info of an existing affix entry.

fromInflectionClass.description: Optional id of an inflection class owned by the From category or an ancestor; omission leaves the current link unchanged.

clearFromInflectionClass.description: Set true to remove the current From Inflection Class; do not combine with fromInflectionClass.

fromExceptionFeatures.description: Optional exact set of valid From Exception Features; an empty list removes them all, and omission leaves the current set unchanged.

toInflectionClass.description: Optional id of an inflection class owned by the To category or an ancestor; derived stems get this class. Omission leaves the current link unchanged.

clearToInflectionClass.description: Set true to remove the current To Inflection Class; do not combine with toInflectionClass.

toExceptionFeatures.description: Optional exact set of To Exception Features, which the derived stem receives; an empty list removes them all, and omission leaves the current set unchanged.

alsoMsas.description: Optional ids of further derivational grammatical info that receive the identical change, so one intent edits many affixes.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_author_exception_feature
description:
Add an exception feature. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. Add a feature only for a lexical class with a reason, since a feature per stem is just a stem list (guides suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a new exception feature in the project's Exception Features list, the tag that stems carry and affixes or rules can require. It refuses a name the list already has. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-exception-feature. Agent class: Draft.

name.description: Name of the feature, such as the class of stems it marks.

ws.description: Writing system tag of the name and abbreviation.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_exception_features
description:
Set exception features. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. For a stem, clitic or inflectional affix. A derivational affix uses compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction (guides suffix-prefix-slots). Sets the exact exception features a stem or clitic carries, or the ones an inflectional affix requires of its stem. An empty list clears the set. Derivational affixes use their own command. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-exception-features. Agent class: Draft.

msa.description: Id of the grammatical info of a stem, clitic or inflectional affix entry.

exceptionFeatures.description: Exact set of exception feature ids; an empty list removes them all.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_phonological_rule_features
description:
Set rule features. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. For a rule that exists. Tag the stems with compose-edit-exception-features first. Sets the exact exception features or inflection classes a phonological rewrite rule requires of a stem, and the ones it excludes. An empty list clears a set. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-phonological-rule-features. Agent class: Draft.

rule.description: Id of an existing regular rule with one right-hand side; for several, use compose-edit-phonological-rule with rightHandSides.

requiredFeatures.description: Exact set of exception feature or inflection class ids a stem must all carry; an empty list clears it.

excludedFeatures.description: Exact set of ids a stem must carry none of; an empty list clears it.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
